classification: Static candidate for verification, not a broker reproduction or formal review finding
candidate: Ready routing key colliding with the durable failure binding can acknowledge publication to the failure queue without making ready work consumable
scenario: A previous failure event establishes a durable failure_queue binding for delivery.failure_routing_key
Operator sets delivery.routing_key equal to delivery.failure_routing_key while delivery.binding_key remains the normal ready key
Publishing a ready event routes to the failure queue, so mandatory/confirm may succeed even though the normal consumer queue receives nothing
Dispatcher marks the outbox published; the delivery is still pending and reserved/sending recovery does not select it
suggested_verification: After the current full handle is terminal, use an owned isolated topology and real broker to compare normal/failure queue counts, publication result and SQL state. Do not change the current frozen sources before terminal.
possible_resolution_if_confirmed: Fail closed on ready/failure routing or binding collision before broker IO, preserving valid distinct-key and mandatory-return behavior
not_the_prior_rebutted_issue: Publisher already rejects failure queue equal to the Laravel jobs queue; do not reopen that old allegation
